parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: The slider is a small plastic lever located on the side of the toaster, used to lower and raise the bread carriage.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to start the toasting process by pushing it down, engaging the heating elements and timer mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically along a guided slot, typically spring-loaded to return to its original position when the toast is done.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the toaster, typically made of stainless steel for durability and heat resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the internal heating elements, wiring, and mechanical components, providing structural support and safety.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed frame for all other moving parts.
